text.text: Each event has its own guests, vendors, tasks, budget and run-of-show. Filter any list by the event you are working on.
The week after an event is when the best lessons are still fresh and the last bills are still easy to find. Do this list within seven days.
What took longer than planned, and by how much?
Which vendor would you hire again, and which not?
Which line in the budget surprised you?
Write the answers in the event row so the next planner can read them before booking anything.
